rca of the issue: Bug: POST /api/staff/traversees accepts hotesse role. Reproduction: login as hotesse.test@boulay.ci, POST /api/staff/traversees with any body -> 200 OK. RCA: server.py:3535-3545 _require_role expands `staff.role` via ROLE_INCLUDES; line 3555 declares `'hotesse': ['hotesse','manager','receptionist']` to allow hôtesses to update booking statuses. Side-effect: every endpoint guarded by `_require_role([manager, admin])` (including traversee POST, bateau CRUD, package CRUD…) is reachable by hôtesses. Mitigation: either drop 'manager' from hotesse inheritance (would require auditing every PATCH /staff/bookings/*/status endpoint to allow 'hotesse' explicitly), or introduce a capability check at the traversee POST endpoint that excludes hotesse — e.g. `if staff.get('role') == 'hotesse': raise 403`.
